task: Auto Match paused Back and Leave Pool failure
scope: Targeted defect regression, not whole-App page verification or App Store acceptance
root_cause: Preference changes reselect a candidate and clear expires_at while paused. The previous global validator required an expiry again after transitioning that paused attempt to left, so the atomic transaction rejected and rolled back the exit.

fix.invariant: A finite search_ready_at is always required. Any non-null expires_at must be finite. A candidate in searching/found/waiting still requires a finite expiry; paused and terminal states do not require a running candidate countdown.
preserved: Leave confirmation and Home return ownership
No fabricated expiry or new charge

covers: No duplicate quota or coin mutation

browser.storage: Isolated browser contexts; no existing app storage accessed
browser.warnings: 10 existing uni statistics retry warnings because this regression intentionally blocks external requests; no business page errors
checks: Back confirmation and Stay cancellation do not write
Double leave confirmation writes once and clears the stack to Home
Home refresh never revives the left attempt
Direct Leave Pool after refresh succeeds
Double Resume restores 5790ms and refresh retains its deadline without new charges
browser.cleanup: All test Chrome contexts and browser closed; no preview service was started

wkwebview.build: xcodebuild -project ios/cimoaNeapo/cimoaNeapo.xcodeproj -scheme cimoaNeapo -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination id=D9B138D2-1B08-4646-B8D0-8A2242AECD7D -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/cimoa-paused-exit-20261026 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build
wkwebview.method: Touch controls in Simulator UI, with visual inspection of the resulting WKWebView state
checks: Existing paused match opens from Home
Back opens leave confirmation without the deadline error
Stay in Pool returns to the unchanged paused page
Direct Leave Pool opens the same confirmation
Confirm Leave shows branded busy feedback and returns to Home without the deadline error
Paused match card disappears; remaining daily quota still displays 2
Terminate and relaunch retains Home without reviving the paused card; existing contact cards remain
wkwebview.data_boundary: No uninstall or app-data reset. The existing paused test-account attempt was explicitly left through its UI as part of this requested fix; no new admission, purchase, or message was created.
not_claimed: New native permissions or StoreKit purchase acceptance

workspace: Only the validator, two new regression scripts, this evidence and generated outputs belong to this task. Pre-existing source changes, staged deletions and signing files were preserved. No git stage, commit, push, standalone archive overwrite, or convention edit was performed.
